ModMetaData.name: Ordered Work (Core)
ModMetaData.author: nightmare123487
ModMetaData.description: Work Control (0.3.0-alpha.13). Bug-fix iteration. The Work search is now a single searchable combo (no separate Work label/text): its dropdown shows at most 10 WorkTypes plus Any with an integrated thin scrollbar, and the typed text filters the palette chips and the pawn rows by defName/label/labelShort. The Not control is a real checkbox with the tooltip "Show pawns without the selected work". The horizontal lane bar is fixed above the matrix and is independent from the vertical bar: separate drag state and show flags, both gutters reserved, no mutual blocking; names scroll only vertically, lanes share the horizontal offset, auto-hide remains, and the last row stays complete. Lane cards are 20% tighter (~117 px) and the ghost/remove/ellipsis follow. Vanilla passion icons are tinted with distinct warm colours (minor yellow, major orange) in the lane, palette drag card and Details without tinting the card. Colonist-bar order, hover-based drag targets, ghost/colors, simple/manual Work-tab fixes, return button, right-click max, selection, Recommend/Details, auto-recommend and save/load are kept. No profiles, schedules, equipment or multi-pawn. Do not use in a main save; back up your save first.
